title: Break Free
description:
You can play {{DEGAGE-001|this Skill}} only if you are {{entrave}}. You can play it only on your {{tour}}.

Make a {{jet}} ({{force}} + {{athletisme}}) or ({{dexterite}} + {{acrobaties}}), your choice, against the {{dd}} of whatever made you {{entrave}}. On a success, you are no longer {{entrave}}.
